title: The Patient Well
author: Ulyana Reyes
blurb: Freya Hartwell, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must finish the ritual the founders started before the last resident signs the papers.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
